definitions.explanation: An official warning issued by authorities, especially the Japan Meteorological Agency, to alert the public about potential weather hazards. Less severe than a {警報|けいほう} (warning).

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧{注意報|ちゅういほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A heavy rain advisory was issued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧{注意報|ちゅういほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A strong wind advisory has been issued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{波浪|はろう}→波浪：18154_harou⟧{注意報|ちゅういほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近|ちか}づかないで→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: A wave advisory has been in effect since this morning, so please stay away from the ocean.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan's weather alert system, {注意報|ちゅういほう} is a lower-level alert than ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧ (warning), which in turn is lower than ⟦{特別警報|とくべつけいほう}→特別警報：20800_tokubetsukeihou⟧ (special warning). Common types include ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧{注意報|ちゅういほう} (heavy rain advisory), ⟦{強風|きょうふう}→強風：15269_kyoufuu⟧{注意報|ちゅういほう} (strong wind advisory), and ⟦{雷|かみなり}→雷：02197_kaminari⟧{注意報|ちゅういほう} (thunder advisory).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注意報|ちゅういほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (an advisory is issued)
- {注意報|ちゅういほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}される→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧ (an advisory is lifted)
- {注意報|ちゅういほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発令|はつれい}→発令：09516_hatsurei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to issue an advisory)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{警報|けいほう}→警報：09515_keihou⟧: warning — a more severe level of alert, indicating greater danger
- ⟦{特別警報|とくべつけいほう}→特別警報：20800_tokubetsukeihou⟧: special warning — the highest level, for extraordinary danger
